suggested_experiment_name: Crab Nebula VHE gamma hidden photon oscillation
notes: Hidden photon (dark photon) constraints from photon-hidden photon oscillations using VHE gamma-rays from Crab Nebula. The exclusion converges to chi >= 0.0343 for increasing mass, valid up to mu ~ 1e-5 eV (coherence condition). Constraint quoted at 68.3% C.L. (not standard 90/95%, but 0.90 selected as nearest option). The mixing convention here is chi = sin(chi) mixing angle, roughly equal to canonical kinetic mixing epsilon. Data from Fig. 2 / Table 1 (combined value). | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.8, 45)) | Vision: 68.3% C.L. exclusion from Crab Nebula VHE spectrum (HEGRA, HESS, MAGIC, Whipple). Boundary drops from chi~1 at ~3e-8 eV, reaching a minimum ~0.037 near 2e-7 eV with a small kink/dip feature around 2.6e-7 eV, then flattens to chi≈0.0343 at higher masses. Y-axis is kinetic mixing chi (labeled χ). | Calibration: No calibration needed (spot-check verify/stage2 raw_ratio=0.67 snapped to identity)
